correctness.rationale: Substituting Pi yields bi^2*t^2=ai*t^2 and the residual cubic ai^3+ai+1=0; cubic discriminant -31 means distinct ai and nonzero, so no finite-base pairwise intersections. At unique ramified infinity choose v with t=v^-2. Minimal coordinates X=v^2*x, Y=v^3*y give smooth fiber Y^2=X^3+X at v=0, and section expansions P0=(0,v^3), Pi=(ai*v^2,bi*v) have four different first Y-slopes, so the six intersections are transverse with multiplicity one at a single smooth point; no section meets O. Li–Liu prove twelve I1 fibers and chi(O_X)=1. Shioda height formula, no reducible corrections, gives diagonal 2 and off-diagonal 1-1=0, so 2I4 and independent non-torsion. On C(t), infinity valuations give I0-star plus six I1, and Oguiso–Shioda table row 9 yields MW lattice D4* det 1/4; base-change heights scale by two, so rational frame has determinant 1, index two. Independent exact SymPy identities for cubic, squarefree sextic, local smoothness, and section equation passed. This does not establish full rank over C(B).

value.rationale: The motivating Li–Liu construction produces just one displayed non-torsion section on higher-genus (-1)-curve surfaces. This work gives explicit orthogonal generators for a rank-four subgroup, with a sharp common-fiber transverse intersection pattern and exact index relation to the classical rational lattice, uniformly for all eligible covers. The coordinate-level frame is reusable concrete geometry and not merely the already known abstract rank-four theorem.
